subtheme: Understanding what's in images and video

subsubthemes.name: Labeling and drawing boundaries around objects
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that detect where objects are in images, draw boxes or outlines around them, and identify what type each thing is.

subsubthemes.name: Telling stories about what's happening in video
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that watch a video over time and describe the action, changes, or movements happening frame by frame.

subsubthemes.name: Spotting fake or tampered images
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that figure out when an image has been faked, doctored, or created by AI instead of a camera.

subsubthemes.name: Connecting words to what you see
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that link text descriptions to regions in images, or use language to guide what a model focuses on.

subsubthemes.name: Building 3d understanding from 2d images
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that reconstruct 3D shapes, scenes, and spatial layouts from flat photographs or videos.

subsubthemes.name: Handling messy real-world data
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that keep models working well when data changes, appears partially labeled, or comes from different sources than training.

subsubthemes.name: Making models work with less help from humans
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that teach models to understand new concepts using few examples or no manual labels, or transfer learning from general models.
